canvasww-canvasww:lever:ccb35d0b-61d4-42.description: Canvas Worldwide dares to be the challenger the ad industry needs. Do you "Challenge the Comfortable?" Then you'll fit right in here at Canvas. Recognized as one of Ad Age's "Best Places to Work" for three consecutive years, Canvas Worldwide is an independent media agency committed to providing creative solutions for brands that challenge the status quo. Our clients include Hyundai, Kia, Genesis, MGM, Zillow and McDonald’s (to name a few…). Our agency cultivates an environment where all are welcome to push outside their comfort zones to solve problems in new ways. We encourage the team to be its best by creating the most positive workplace experience for all. For instance, we outpace the industry on diversity and inclusion AND offer continuous training and workshops for career development. So, if you dare to challenge the comfortable… then keep reading. The Role As a Specialist on the Out of Home (OOH) team, your core responsibility is to steward OOH campaigns from inception through to fruition. You will receive hands on training in traditional and digital OOH partners and executions, and work closely with the team to deliver all required materials to support recommendations and stewardship. While heavily integrated in the planning phase the Specialist is also responsible for the oversite of the day-to-day maintenance of the accounts, supported by the Associate Specialist. Additionally, The Specialist, supported by the Supervisor, will be responsible for training the Associates. Key Duties/Responsibilities & Desired Knowledge Base: • Autonomously manage day-to-day maintenance with little to no oversight • Oversight of maintenance across assigned account(s) • Billing/Contracting/invoicing, trafficking and post reporting of campaigns • Train direct reports to be self-sufficient to the point that they are able to manage the day-to-day maintenance on accounts with little to no oversight and then encourage/empower them to do so, once ready • Showcase ability to produce a high-quality level of work • Understanding of basic media terms and concepts • Familiarity with OOH industry partners: Geopath & OAAA • In depth knowledge of OOH formats, vendors and markets • Experience planning across a variety of OOH verticals: Required: traditional, tra-digital/digital, digital placed based Preferred: experiential, event partnerships/event targeted, traditional embellishments (ex. extensions, props/builds, illumination, etc.) • Participate in strategy development and brainstorming meetings with ability to work harmoniously with internal teams on projects from start to finish • Steward OOH plans Including but not limited to: understand objectives of the assignment, delegation if workload, management of timeline/deadlines, writing RFP’s (consist of the ability to ensure all applicable relevant vendors are included), negotiations, clear articulation of strategy, oversee post-buy tasks (production, trafficking, installation, post reporting) • Ability to compile and present topline 101’s/Overviews /new market opportunities (on own or assist Sr. Specialist/Supervisor); showcasing ability to research and compile rationale • Participate in/attend onsite and offsite meetings/trainings • Participate in/attend market rides as needed Qualifications/Skills: Characteristics: • Innate curiosity and desire to learn • Inquisitive nature – not shy to ask questions until an answer is satisfied Aptitude for critical thinking and problem solving • Self-starter who approaches workload with a positive attitude • Proactive (vs reactive) approach to projects/workload • Strong communication skills (written & verbal) • Acute attention to detail • Highly organized, including time management • Holds self accountable for errors/mistakes Competencies: • Complete assigned projects in a timely manner • Multitask across numerous projects/accounts • Prioritize and reprioritize "to-do list” accordingly • Effectively and fairly delegate workload • Synthesize large volumes of infor

Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Resident Chef at Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the store by leading high-performing culinary teams that inspire customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. This position leads engaging cooking classes, fostering an enthusiastic and knowledgeable team and overseeing the success of the in-store culinary program. This role requires a blend of culinary talent, business acumen, and teaching skills to drive sales, enhance customer #bestincenter experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, and build a high-performing culinary team. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Team Development · Recruit, mentor and retain a high-performing team to meet the business needs of both culinary and retail. · Lead, coach, and inspire associates to exceed performance expectations and uphold a positive team culture. · Conduct regular performance evaluations, provide feedback, and create development plans to support individual and team growth. Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Ensures an outstanding cooking class experience in every session by following provided recipes and game plans while holding employees accountable for quality and execution. · Work with store leadership to increase foot traffic and store engagement through cooking classes and private events. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture in both the kitchen and retail sales floor. · Oversees, addresses, and takes responsibility for all customer feedback related to the culinary program to maintain satisfaction and loyalty. Sales & Business Performance · Drive sales growth by developing and implementing strategies to enhance the culinary and retail business. · Analyze key performance metrics daily and leverage insights to optimize store performance. · Consistently meet or exceed culinary and retail goals by delivering exceptional classes and customer experiences that drive engagement and sales. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail product sales, individual sales volume, average transaction value, customer conversion rates, and guest feedback through Google reviews. Operations & Compliance · Manage daily store operations while ensuring compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Maintains the accuracy and integrity of employee records, including but not limited to time and attendance data, food safety certifications, and personal information. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to associates, maintained and consistently followed. jobgether-jobgether:lever:04f9f9a1-1de4-.title: Data Governance Analyst
jobgether-jobgether:lever:04f9f9a1-1de4-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Governance Analyst based in Brazil. This role offers the opportunity to shape how critical enterprise data is governed, protected, and used across a large-scale modernization program. You will help establish practical governance frameworks, standards, and operating models that support data quality, security, privacy, and compliance. Working across business, technical, legal, security, and records management teams, you will turn complex requirements into clear and actionable controls. You will also contribute to data stewardship, metadata, lineage, classification, and governance maturity initiatives. The position combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a data-driven environment. It is well suited to an experienced governance professional who enjoys creating structure, improving data practices, and influencing teams through clear standards and collaboration. Support the development, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of data governance frameworks, policies, standards, procedures, and operating models. Act as a Data Standards Architect by defining and maintaining data standards, naming conventions, business definitions, data structures, reference data, and governance requirements. Align data governance practices with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, records management, and regulatory requirements. Establish clear data ownership, stewardship, accountability, and decision-rights models, including RACI structures across business and technical teams. Partner with Data Stewards, Data Owners, business stakeholders, security, privacy, legal, records management, and technology teams to operationalize governance requirements. Classify and manage data assets according to their sensitivity, criticality, business value, privacy requirements, and regulatory obligations. Translate policies and regulatory requirements into practical data governance controls, procedures, and operational processes. Identify governance gaps, risks, and compliance issues and coordinate appropriate remediation activities. Support data access, sharing, usage, and lifecycle governance processes while ensuring appropriate privacy and security controls. Participate in governance councils, working groups, and data domain forums, contributing expertise and helping drive consistent adoption. Create and maintain governance documentation, standards, procedures, decision logs, glossaries, lineage information, and supporting artifacts. Monitor the adoption and effectiveness of governance policies and standards and report program metrics, maturity, and compliance status to leadership. Support governance assessments, audits, compliance reviews, maturity evaluations, roadmaps, and continuous improvement initiatives. Develop training materials and deliver awareness sessions that help teams understand data governance policies, standards, and regulatory expectations. Requirements Master’s degree in a relevant field, with 5+ years of general experience in information systems and 7+ years of specialized experience, or equivalent demonstrated expertise. Demonstrated experience supporting or implementing enterprise data governance programs and operating models. Strong ability to translate governance policies and regulatory requirements into practical processes, controls, and delivery practices. Solid understanding of data quality management, metadata management, data stewardship, classification, and governance frameworks. Experience governing sensitive, regulated, or high-risk data within environments with strict compliance requirements. Hands-on experience with data quality profiling, monitoring techniques, and common data governance tooling. Experience defining and maintaining enterprise data standards across multiple teams, platforms, or delivery environments. Strong knowledge of data modeling, data integration patterns,

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4168d878-2a94-.title: Social Media Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:4168d878-2a94-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Social Media Manager based in Germany. This is a creative, hands-on opportunity for a social media professional passionate about photography, visual storytelling, and digital culture. You will own social media strategy across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, helping shape the voice and presence of a globally recognized creative brand. The role combines strategic planning, content creation, performance analysis, and creator collaboration. You will experiment with new formats, trends, and storytelling approaches to discover what resonates with audiences at scale. Your work will directly influence brand awareness, community engagement, and the growth of social channels. You will join a collaborative and flexible environment where creativity, autonomy, and continuous learning are encouraged. This position is ideal for someone with strong visual instincts who enjoys taking ideas from concept through production, publication, and optimization. Develop and own the social media strategy, translating broader brand objectives into engaging, platform-specific content. Define channel strategies for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, including content pillars, editorial calendars, formats, and publishing plans. Identify emerging platform trends, content opportunities, and audience behaviors to keep the social strategy relevant and competitive. Plan, create, edit, and publish high-quality social content aligned with a premium visual identity. Produce short-form videos and other social-first creative assets designed to maximize engagement and audience growth. Continuously improve creative quality by testing new concepts, formats, hooks, storytelling techniques, and visual approaches. Establish performance metrics and reporting processes across social platforms. Monitor content performance, analyze audience behavior, and translate data into actionable recommendations. Run creative experiments and content tests to determine what drives the strongest engagement and growth. Collaborate with photographers, ambassadors, and creators to develop campaigns and compelling community-driven stories. Brief creators on campaigns and content requirements and help curate and repurpose user- and creator-generated content. Manage the social media workflow independently, from ideation and planning through production, publication, analysis, and optimization. Requirements At least 2 years of experience managing social media for a brand. Demonstrated experience growing Instagram, TikTok, and/or YouTube audiences organically. Strong portfolio showcasing high-performing social media content and creative work. Hands-on experience editing short-form video and producing social-first creative assets. Excellent visual taste and a strong understanding of design, composition, and digital content principles. Strong understanding of social media platforms, content formats, audience behavior, and platform algorithms. Experience using analytics and performance data to evaluate and improve content strategies. Ability to combine creative thinking with a data-driven and experimentation-focused mindset. Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of projects from initial concept through publication. Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with creators and cross-functional stakeholders. A genuine interest in photography is a strong advantage, whether as a hobby or through professional experience. Familiarity with photo editing tools such as Luminar, Lightroom, Photoshop, or similar software is a plus. Benefits Remote working opportunity, with flexibility around how and where you work. Full-time employment in a creative and collaborative environment. Opportunity to contribute to award-winning photo editing products and a globally recognized visual brand. Educational allowance to support ongoing professional develop

jobgether-jobgether:lever:b641323f-dc64-.title: Senior Mobile Game UI/UX Artist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:b641323f-dc64-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Game UI/UX Artist based in Canada. This is a senior creative role focused on shaping intuitive, expressive, and highly engaging interfaces for mobile games enjoyed by players around the world. You will define the visual identity of the game UI while building scalable systems that keep experiences consistent across devices and screen sizes. The role combines visual design, UX thinking, prototyping, design systems, and close collaboration with game development teams. You will transform concepts into polished interfaces, seamlessly blending 2D UI with 3D game assets while maintaining strong hierarchy and visual impact. You will also contribute to modern AI-assisted workflows that accelerate ideation, exploration, and asset creation. Success requires both artistic excellence and a systems mindset, with a strong understanding of mobile gaming conventions and player behavior. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact in a fast-moving, remote-friendly environment where creativity, experimentation, and collaboration are highly valued. Define and own the visual direction, layout, interaction patterns, and overall artistic quality of mobile game interfaces. Create high-fidelity 2D UI assets, icons, screens, menus, and interactive elements that are colorful, polished, intuitive, and optimized for mobile devices. Integrate 2D UI layers with 3D game assets while maintaining visual hierarchy, depth, readability, and a cohesive aesthetic. Build, scale, and maintain a component-driven UI design system in Figma, including reusable components, variants, variables, auto-layout structures, and responsive behaviors. Design modular and reusable UI components that account for mobile platform constraints and different screen sizes and aspect ratios. Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, interactive prototypes, and iconography that prioritize intuitive navigation, touch ergonomics, and engaging player interactions. Design interfaces for modern free-to-play meta systems, including progression tracks, Battle Passes, collection systems, rewards, and other engagement features. Collaborate closely with programmers, technical artists, producers, and other creative stakeholders to ensure designs are implemented accurately and retain their intended visual quality in-engine. Use generative AI and AI-assisted design tools to accelerate brainstorming, mood-board development, concept exploration, iteration, and asset generation. Maintain clear design documentation and communicate UI logic and design-system principles effectively to technical and creative teams. Contribute to UI animations, visual effects, and other implementation considerations where appropriate. Continuously refine the player experience by balancing visual excitement with clarity, usability, consistency, and performance. Requirements 10+ years of professional game-art experience, including at least 5 years specializing in UI/UX art. A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional mobile game UI/UX work, including visual case studies or references from at least 2 shipped mobile titles. Excellent understanding of composition, color theory, typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and stylized 2D game-art production. Deep knowledge of mobile game UI principles, including touch interfaces, gesture controls, ergonomics, and iOS/Android design considerations. Strong understanding of free-to-play game meta systems such as Battle Passes, progression tracks, collection systems, and reward loops. Expert-level proficiency with Figma, including auto-layout, nested components, variables, variants, design systems, and interactive prototyping. Strong proficiency with Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for high-fidelity asset creation, iconography, vectors, textures, and visual treatments. Proven experience creating and managing comprehensive UI design systems and style

jobgether-jobgether:lever:c69dcaac-d368-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Account Manager based in Switzerland. As a Technical Account Manager, you will serve as a strategic and technical partner to large enterprise customers throughout their entire journey. You will guide customers from onboarding and implementation through long-term adoption, retention, and expansion. The role combines technical expertise, project management, customer success, and consultative problem-solving. You will work closely with Sales, Support, Engineering, and other teams to deliver solutions that create measurable customer value. Your curiosity and ability to understand complex data environments will help customers get the most from a sophisticated technology platform. You will also bring customer feedback and emerging use cases back to internal teams to influence product evolution. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact in a fast-moving, collaborative, and technology-driven environment. Own the technical customer journey from kickoff and onboarding through ongoing success, adoption, retention, and expansion. Manage and execute customer-facing technical projects, ensuring onboarding activities are well organized, timely, and aligned with customer objectives. Build strong relationships with enterprise customers and develop a deep understanding of their business requirements, technical environments, use cases, and challenges. Provide proactive technical guidance and recommend best practices to help customers maximize the value and adoption of the platform. Partner closely with Sales and Customer Success teams to identify opportunities to increase platform adoption and support the growth of strategic accounts. Collaborate with Customer Support, Engineering, and other internal teams to investigate and resolve complex technical issues and escalations. Translate customer requirements into practical, efficient solutions while helping customers navigate complex technical systems. Identify emerging customer use cases, recurring challenges, and product opportunities, and communicate these insights to Engineering and other product teams. Serve as a trusted advisor who can balance technical depth with business priorities and customer outcomes. Manage competing priorities, deadlines, and unexpected roadblocks while maintaining a high standard of customer service. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in a client-facing and/or technology-focused role combining strong business understanding with technical expertise. Demonstrated experience managing and delivering technical projects with a customer-first mindset and strong empathy for customer needs. Excellent project management, organization, written communication, and verbal communication skills. Strong ability to quickly learn new technologies and understand complex technical environments, including SQL, databases, APIs, reporting tools, and related systems. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities, with a genuine interest in continuously developing technical expertise. Ability to understand customer requirements at a detailed level and translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical recommendations. Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders with different technical backgrounds and responsibilities. Ability to remain composed and effective under pressure, manage deadlines, and navigate unexpected challenges with confidence. A customer-oriented, curious, proactive, and consultative approach, with the ability to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders. Willingness and ability to work in a fast-paced technology environment where priorities can evolve quickly. Benefits: Competitive compensation package. The Superintendent serves as the highest-ranking field manager and is responsible for overall project execution, production, quality control, safety, subcontractor coordination, and schedule management. The successful candidate will maintain a continuous onsite presence, ensure compliance with project specifications, drawings, and applicable codes, and work closely with Project Managers, Owners, Architects, Engineers, and Quality Control personnel to successfully deliver projects on schedule and within budget. Required Qualifications: · High School Diploma or GED required. · Associate's or Bachelor's Degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or related field preferred. · Minimum 7 years of commercial construction experience. · Minimum 5 years serving as a Superintendent managing commercial, institutional, or federal construction projects. · Experience supervising multiple subcontractors simultaneously. · Strong knowledge of construction sequencing, scheduling, and quality control procedures. · Ability to interpret construction drawings, specifications, contracts, and technical documents. · Knowledge of New York City Building Codes and construction regulations. · Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills. · Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities. · Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite. · Experience with Procore, Autodesk Build, Bluebeam, Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or similar construction management software.
